atq.text: Feldon is a scholar who, on an expedition, finds the first of his mystical canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier. He co-founds the Union of the Third Path, which seeks neutrality in the Brothers' War, and meets Loran, while the Yumok fishermen accidentally net the Golgothian Sylex and send it to him, along with the Coral Helm.

During the fall of Terisia City, Feldon sends Loran away with the Sylex since his lame leg would slow her, but she is caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captures her and tortures her. After ten years Loran escapes or is let go and finds Feldon, and they marry and live near the Ronom Glacier.
When the Sylex Blast is triggered, Feldon and Loran realize the war is over. Loran dies ten years later, and Feldon grieves and tries to replace her with an automaton before giving up.

He seeks out other mages to bring Loran back, and a black mage teaches him a spell in exchange for his cane that creates a zombified Loran, which Feldon unsummons. A white scholar teaches him that magic can only summon copies, so Feldon creates a copy of Loran, says goodbye and lets her go, then gets over his grief, shares his library, and becomes important in early magical research.
